names.name: พัก จ็อง-ฮวัน
ชเว ชอลฮัน

notes: Bermuda corpus analysis strongly associates the source spelling 'Lee Yeonggu' with this identity, but that exact spelling is not present in the adopted u-go snapshot and is therefore not yet approved for the distributed catalogue.

The preferred display name is 'Wang Lei'. Source spellings include 'Wang Lei Sr.' and 'Wang Lei (b)' to distinguish this player from another player with the same romanised name. Bermuda should revisit user-facing disambiguation when that second identity is catalogued.
